name: MiniSearch
description: Self-hosted search engine with an AI assistant that can run entirely inside the browser tab.
whatItDoes: Gives private web search with AI-written answers, without accounts, tracking or required API keys. It suits individuals who want a lightweight personal answer engine.
howItWorks: A single Docker container bundles a SearXNG metasearch instance and the web app. Results are re-ranked locally and the language model can run in the browser on GPU or CPU, so no inference server is needed.
models: In-browser models by default; external inference optional
